title: Vice President, Regulatory Data Governance
full_description:
COO | Regional Data Office | VP, Regulatory Data Governance | New York
In Americas, ING’s Wholesale Banking division offers a broad range of innovative financial products and services to domestic and international corporate and institutional clients.
When you come to work at ING, you’re joining a team where individuality isn’t just accepted, it’s encouraged. We’ve built a culture that’s fun, friendly and supportive – it’s the kind of place where you can be yourself and make the most of whatever you have to offer.We give people the freedom to take risks, think differently, take ownership of their work, and make great things happen. We’re here to help you get ahead. And with our global network, there’s plenty of scope to take your career in new directions, perhaps even ones you’ve never considered. ING Americas follows a hybrid work model, allowing for in-office / work from home flexibility. Hybrid work arrangements vary based on business area.
Sound like the kind of place you’d feel at home? We’d love to hear from you.
Data is at the heart of everything we do at ING. It powers how we measure risk, assess performance, and make decisions. To ensure we unlock the full value of our data, we must guarantee its completeness, accuracy, auditability, traceability, and protection.
With emerging trends such as digital wallets on the horizon and increasing regulatory expectations around data governance, CDO is evolving to meet these challenges head-on, ensuring our data remains both a strategic asset and a safeguarded resource.
The purpose of the Regional Data Office is to drive the execution of ING’s data strategy, implementing ING’s data governance frameworks, standards, and policies, including Data Management Control Standards (DM CS), models, reports, and EUC control standards, data protection, and Data & AI ethics over local data flows, models, reports, and data products. Regional Chief Data Officer leads local regulatory reporting on data management to regulators, ensuring BCBS239 compliance.
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Governance and BCBS 239 Expert to
contribute to the orchestration of the end-to-end work needed to increase the ING Americas compliance towards data controls, while, at the same time, help driving business value. You will work closely with the Regional Chief Data Officer (RCDO) and Data Governance/Data Protection Expert to strengthen governance policies and accelerate the implementation of data controls—such as standards for data management, reporting, and models—across the ING Americas organization. You will hierarchically report into the Regional Chief Data Officer/Lead Regional Data Office Americas.
About the department:
As COO Wholesale Banking Americas, we ensure our Wholesale Banking clients a superior customer experience with our scalable operations providing seamless, digital services, while staying safe & secure.
COO department focuses on Client Service Delivery (CSD), Financial Crime Prevention (FCP), Operational Design Control and Resilience (ODCR), and the Regional Data Office (RDO).
Implement global policies, control standards, and frameworks to meet the required control objectives, and develop local equivalent as needed.
Translate global regulatory priorities into local execution.
Manage the planning and delivery of BCBS 239 remediation effort within the BCBS 239 program, ensuring integration across deliverables.
Progress tracking through heatmap. Oversight implementation via dedicated metrics and dashboards.
Anticipate and balance the needs of multiple stakeholders, coordinate workshops and stakeholders’ meetings,
Apply global platforms (e.g., Collibra) to support data governance and operational efficiency. Monitor and review operations to ensure quality standards and desired results within area of responsibility are consistent with the overall strategy and mission.
Contribute to progress reports and updates on data governance related topics.
Maintain clear and accurate documentation for audit readiness.
Be a trusted advisor to the Data Community in ING’s ambition towards compliance by design.
Assist in preparation of presentations, training materials, knowledge-sharing sessions organized for the data community
Qualifications and Competencies
We are looking for a proactive, influential, detail-oriented and self-motivated professional who can work independently and can navigate complex, cross-functional initiatives with confidence.
You are a clear communicator, capable of balancing multiple priorities with clarity and confidence, simplifying technical concepts and fostering understanding across diverse stakeholders. You bring strong organizational skills, a strategic mindset, and the ability to inspire and coordinate teams toward shared goals. With a natural inclination for structured problem-solving and continuous learning, you take initiative, adapt to ambiguity, and build trust as a reliable advisor within the data community.
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Business Administration (with a focus on data management or compliance), or a related field.
Over 10+ years of professional experience managing data within a banking (FBO) or financial institution.
Strong knowledge of Fed, NYDFS, BCBS 239, and other regulations related to Data Management
Skilled in assessing current data practices to identify gaps and potential vulnerabilities.
Experienced practitioner able to work with minimum supervision and provides guidance as required on identifying, managing and controlling project-related changes.
Proven ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and drive initiatives.
Easily adapt to a new environment and take responsibility to get the work done.
Strong teamwork and collaboration skills with experience working cross-functionally.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and leadership abilities.
Uses clear and effective verbal communications skills and provides technical guidance when required on expressing ideas, requesting actions and formulating plans or policies.
Communicate effectively with all relevant stakeholders
Collaborates with others to meet shared objectives and help shapes direction
It will be an advantage if you have the following experience:
Proficient understanding and experience in Wholesale banking business and/or operations and IT
Experience in Risk and/or Internal Control Management
Experienced with tools such as Collibra, Informatica, or Azure native data governance services.
Salary Range $168,000-205,000
In addition to comprehensive health benefits, a generous 401k savings plan, and competitive PTO, ING provides a broad array of benefits including adoption, surrogacy, and fertility services; student debt assistance; and subsidies for expenses associated with commuting and fitness.
ING is a committed equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of diverse backgrounds and hire without regard to race, gender, religion, national origin, citizenship, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law. We celebrate these differences and rely upon your unique perspective to innovate and seize new opportunities. Come as you are.
ING Bank does not have a commercial banking license in the U.S. and therefore not permitted to conduct a commercial banking business in the U.S. Through its wholly owned subsidiary ING Financial Services LLC, and its affiliates, it offers a full array of wholesale products such as commercial lending and a full range of FM products and services.
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society. To achieve this vision, our policies support diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind with regard to age, gender, gender identity, cultural background, experience, religion, race, ethnicity, disability, family responsibilities, sexual orientation, social origin, or any other status protected by applicable law.
